name: circuit-design-anything
displayName: Circuit Design Anything (CDA) — Autonomous EDA & SPICE Synthesis
description: Autonomous electronic design automation for AI agents. Run deterministic Modified Nodal Analysis (MNA) SPICE AC sweeps, snap theoretical component values to real-world IEC 60063 standards (E12, E24, E96 1%), and export KiCad PCB netlists directly in Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot.

author.name: Mohammad Hossein Nosrati
author.affiliation: Iran University of Science and Technology (IUST)

tools.name: simulate_ac
tools.description: Performs deterministic Modified Nodal Analysis (MNA) AC frequency simulation on arbitrary two-port networks, computing magnitude, phase, -3dB cutoff frequency, and phase margin.

tools.name: pick_standard_parts
tools.description: Snaps continuous theoretical resistor and capacitor values to commercially manufactured IEC 60063 decades (E12 10%, E24 5%, or E96 1% precision).

tools.name: export_kicad
tools.description: Synthesizes vector schematics and generates complete KiCad PCB netlists and Bill of Materials (BOM) files ready for hardware PCB manufacturing.
